scope: Independent read-only validation of the V4 packaged compact NPZ channels and every row/value in the three fixed-k summary outputs. Recomputed directly from the compact arrays without importing the summary tool. V4 capture is provisional because a generic optional phase-channel name collision was subsequently identified; core state/rate channels used here are expected unchanged, but root requires byte-identical V5 core-channel verification and a fresh summary before publication.
independent_methods: Recomputed the FIX-minus-OLD call-internal sum, between-call net sum, endpoint change, and telescoping residual over each contiguous 180-step interval for hours 1, 2, and 5, retaining all 39 native levels and 150 selected points.
Recomputed phase 8 minus phase 6 and phase 12 minus phase 11 sums directly from the paired compact channel arrays; QR sedimentation remained a separately paired optional term.

Recomputed PREVP, PRAUT, and PRACW nominal rate integrals by multiplying native float32 rates by native float32 dtcld first, then applying the pinned four-corner point weights and summing time at fixed native k.
Rebuilt role-level fixed-k quantiles from the full ledger table and pinned role membership, checking every finite count and all q25/median/q75 values.
limits: This receipt describes V4 collector inputs/outputs only. Do not treat it as the final V5 publication review until the 130 core NPZs are proven byte-identical and the summary is refreshed against V5 collector receipts.
This validates bookkeeping and exact output reproducibility; it is not a new physical attribution or a column/domain conservation closure.
PREVP/PRAUT/PRACW integrals are nominal source terms, not observed net state changes or causal precipitation fractions.
Between-call changes remain net external operations; no ledger bridges steps 361 through 720.
Role memberships overlap, points are spatially correlated, and group quantiles of components do not generally add.
